name: b*nQ
summary: B*nq is a Q*Bert clone brought to the Atari 7800 by Ken Siders. The object of b*nQ is to score as many points as possible by jumping on cubes, jumping on green objects, and luring the snake cop to his death. When all of the cubes have been changed to the “change to” color, you will advance to the next round.

name: Bnuuy Deliverance
summary: A short needle platformer for the Game Boy about the struggles of a mail delivery bunny.

name: BND Legenden: Operation Blackbox
summary: BND Legends: Operation Blackbox is a tactical stealth adventure where you guide agent AJ through a fortified tech compound, infiltrate enemy systems, steal critical data, and complete clever minigames with support from your elite BND team.

name: BND Legenden: Operation Blackout
summary: BND-Legenden: Operation Blackbox ist das erste offizielle Videogame des BND. Das Spiel vermischt Action-Adventure und Stealth mit weiteren beliebten Gaming-Elementen. In einem futuristischen Setting erhält Agentin AJ den Auftrag, geheime Informationen zu einer gefährlichen Cyberwaffe zu beschaffen.
